task: Fix all issues identified in the FINIX Go backend review. Apply changes file-by-file, preserve existing behavior except where the fix explicitly changes it, keep code gofmt-clean, and run `gofmt -l .`, `go vet ./...`, `golangci-lint run ./...`, and `go test ./...` after each group. Do not introduce new dependencies without noting them.

context.language: Go (1.21+ required for log/slog and crypto/ecdh)
context.domain: Banking / fintech backend — security correctness is paramount
context.toolchain_note: gofmt/go vet/golangci-lint were NOT run during review (no Go toolchain in review env). Run them first to catch mechanical issues before applying manual fixes.

conventions.errors: lowercase, no trailing punctuation; wrap underlying causes with fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err); use errors.Is/errors.As at call sites
conventions.logging: log/slog with static messages + key/value attrs; never log secrets, PII, tokens
conventions.concurrency: single held critical section per mutation; never unlock-then-relock across a logical operation
conventions.types: prefer `any` over `interface{}`; accept interfaces, return concrete structs
conventions.crypto: always check crypto/rand errors; use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare for secret comparisons

must_fix.title: Dilithium private key leaks via getter
must_fix.problem: GetCurrentKeyInfo() returns the full DilithiumKeypair including PrivateKey bytes; any handler serializing it leaks the signing private key to clients.
must_fix.fix: Introduce a redacted info struct (e.g. DilithiumKeyInfo) exposing only KeyID, Algorithm, and PublicKey, mirroring PQCManager.GetKeyInfo. Update callers.
must_fix.verify: Confirm no exported method or handler returns PrivateKey bytes; add a test asserting the JSON of the info struct contains no private key field.

must_fix.title: WebAuthn counter mutated through a stale pointer
must_fix.problem: VerifyChallenge captures reg=&pm.registrations[userID][i] under RLock, releases the lock, then re-acquires Lock and mutates reg. A concurrent Register (slice realloc) or RemoveRegistration (element shift) causes a lost update or a write to the wrong record.
must_fix.fix: Re-look up the registration by keyID inside the second (write) critical section and mutate it there; do not carry a pointer across an unlock.
must_fix.verify: Add a -race test that registers/removes concurrently while verifying.

must_fix.title: SIM binding proof code (VNNCode) serialized to client
must_fix.problem: SIMBindingChallenge.VNNCode is tagged json:"vnnCode"; returning the struct hands the client the exact code it must later present, making VerifyBindingChallenge self-attesting.
must_fix.fix: Tag VNNCode as json:"-" (like Verified). Deliver the code out-of-band (SMS/push). Ensure CreateBindingChallenge does not return the code in any JSON response body.
must_fix.verify: Test that the marshaled challenge omits the code.

must_fix.title: eKYC accepts any well-formed XML as verified
must_fix.problem: VerifyAadhaarOfflineXML sets Verified:true for any parseable XML; UIDAI digital signature is never validated and share code only checked for non-emptiness.
must_fix.fix: If this is a mock, gate it behind a build tag (e.g. //go:build mock_ekyc) or force Verified:false with a clear MockOnly marker so it cannot be mistaken for real verification. If real, implement UIDAI signature validation.
must_fix.verify: Document mock status; add a test asserting a fabricated XML is NOT marked Verified in production build.

must_fix.title: CORS wildcard combined with credentials
must_fix.problem: Origin check allows ao=="*" while Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true is set; reflecting arbitrary origin with credentials defeats CORS protection.
must_fix.fix: Disallow "*" when credentials are enabled. Require an explicit allow-list; only echo Access-Control-Allow-Origin for origins in the list. Consider a config flag to disable credentialed CORS.
must_fix.verify: Test that a non-listed origin is rejected and that "*" is never emitted alongside Allow-Credentials:true.

should_fix.title: No request body size limit
should_fix.problem: json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode reads unbounded input; large bodies can exhaust memory.
should_fix.fix: Wrap body with http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, maxBytes) before decoding; choose a sane max (e.g. 1MB) configurable via env.

should_fix.title: Rate-limiter map grows without bound
should_fix.problem: buckets keyed by client IP is never pruned; entries accumulate for process lifetime and are attacker-amplifiable.
should_fix.fix: Add a background sweeper (or lazy prune) removing windows older than `window`; or use a bounded/expiring cache. Ensure sweeper goroutine lifetime is clear/stoppable.

should_fix.title: Kyber rotation grace period is dead code
should_fix.problem: Decapsulate only unpacks ServerKeypair; previousKey is stored/pruned but never consulted, so clients holding the prior public key get garbage shared secrets after RotateKey.
should_fix.fix: In Decapsulate, attempt current key then previousKey within the grace window; return a clear error if neither works.

should_fix.title: Unlock/relock TOCTOU on key rotation
should_fix.problem: MaybeRotate drops the mutex to call RotateKey then re-locks; two concurrent callers can rotate twice back-to-back, evicting the genuinely-old key from `previous`.
should_fix.fix: Add an unexported rotateLocked() invoked under a single held lock; MaybeRotate checks and rotates without releasing the lock mid-operation.

should_fix.title: Non-constant-time secret comparison
should_fix.problem: VNN code (vnnCode != ch.VNNCode) and UBT (record.UBT != ubt) are secrets compared with != — a timing oracle.
should_fix.fix: Use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare (jwt.go:236 already does this correctly).

should_fix.title: Discarded crypto/rand errors yield predictable IDs
should_fix.problem: rand.Read return values ignored; on failure yields all-zero/colliding session IDs, key IDs, challenge IDs, VNN codes, UBTs, JTIs with no error surfaced.
should_fix.fix: Check the error and propagate (as dilithium.go:52 and webauthn.go:63 do). randomHexJWT must return an error rather than a constant zero string; propagate out of IssueToken.

should_fix.title: Revocation lookup fails open
should_fix.problem: Postgres lookup error is swallowed and treated as not-revoked, contradicting the comment; a revoked token is accepted for up to TTL+grace during any DB blip after restart.
should_fix.fix: Decide policy explicitly. For a banking app prefer fail-closed on revocation lookup errors (or make it configurable). Align the comment with the actual behavior.

should_fix.title: Unsalted SHA-256 of Aadhaar number
should_fix.problem: hashUID is unsalted, unkeyed SHA-256 over a small number space — trivially brute-forced offline, defeating the never-store-raw-Aadhaar goal.
should_fix.fix: Use HMAC-SHA256 with a server-side secret key (or a peppered hash). Read key from env/secret store, never hardcode.

should_fix.title: Threat-response reports actions never performed
should_fix.problem: BlockchainLogged, SessionsTerminated, EmailAlertSent etc. set true unconditionally though nothing is wired — false audit trail.
should_fix.fix: Either wire the actions (session store, mailer, ledger) or rename fields to *Requested to reflect intent, not completion.

should_fix.title: Interior pointer escapes the mutex
should_fix.problem: GetBinding returns the live *SIMBindingRecord from inside the guarded map; callers race against ReverifySIM/RevokeBinding.
should_fix.fix: Return a copy of the record (as ListRegistrations does).

should_fix.title: Unbounded challenge / attempt maps
should_fix.lines: webauthn.go 82,112; sim_binding.go challenges map; threat_response.go credentialAttempts/rateLimitEscalated
should_fix.problem: Used challenges flagged Used=true but never deleted; abandoned challenges never swept; IP-keyed maps have attacker-controlled cardinality.
should_fix.fix: Add a TTL janitor / periodic sweep with a clear, stoppable goroutine lifetime; delete used/expired entries.

should_fix.title: dbPool threaded as interface{} with scattered type assertions
should_fix.problem: Empty-interface param inverts accept-interfaces/return-structs; *pgxpool.Pool asserted in multiple places — fragile.
should_fix.fix: Define a small consumer-side Store interface (Exec/QueryRow/Close as needed) and accept that; replace all interface{} with `any` in new code; centralize the single type assertion at the composition root.

should_fix.title: Package-level mutable allowedOrigins
should_fix.problem: var allowedOrigins []string is package-level state appended inside NewRouter; two NewRouter calls (e.g. tests) accumulate origins across instances — latent bug and anti-pattern.
should_fix.fix: Move allowedOrigins into routerOptions/API instance state; build per-router.

should_fix.title: Ignored DB errors on revocation persistence path
should_fix.problem: _, _ = pool.Exec(...) and the lookup query silently drop DB errors on a security-relevant path.
should_fix.fix: Log at Warn with slog (no secrets); consider surfacing lookup errors to the fail-closed policy decision in SF12.

nits.title: auth.go else-if code ladder
nits.fix: After early-returning on success, replace the else-if chain on `code` with a switch statement for readability.

nits.title: Deprecated elliptic.Marshal/Unmarshal
nits.fix: Replace with crypto/ecdh (ecdh.P256()) key encoding; deprecated since Go 1.21.

nits.title: WebAuthn challenge burned before signature check
nits.fix: Only mark Used=true after a successful signature verification, so a malformed attempt or unknown keyID does not permanently consume the challenge.

nits.title: EKYCVerificationResult.KIN declared but never populated
nits.fix: Populate KIN or remove the field to avoid silently emitting an empty value.

nits.title: Misleadingly named regex reused for PAN
nits.fix: Rename aadhaarLast4Regex to a neutral name (e.g. fourDigitsRegex).

nits.title: ParseRole silently downgrades unknown roles
nits.fix: Log unrecognized role strings at Warn before defaulting to RoleCustomer.

nits.title: Preallocate roles slice / prefer nil slice
nits.fix: Use make([]Role, 0, len(roleHierarchy)) since size is known.

nits.title: Zero value not useful for manager types
nits.fix: Document that JWTManager (and peers holding maps) must be built via NewJWTManager; the nil-map zero value would panic.

nits.title: Prefer any over interface{} and confirm gofmt
nits.lines: various (jwt.go 37-43 error block alignment; main.go 165 stray indent)
nits.fix: Run gofmt -w . and goimports; replace interface{} with any in new/edited code.

acceptance_criteria: golangci-lint run ./... passes (errcheck, staticcheck, govet-shadow enabled)
go test -race ./... passes, including new tests for MF1, MF2, MF3, MF4, MF5
No secret/PII/token is serialized to any HTTP response or log
All crypto/rand call sites check and propagate errors
No package-level mutable state introduced by request handling
